title: Darjeeling Tour Package
bestFor: Couples, Families, First-Time Visitors & Slow Travellers
overview: Darjeeling is one of India’s most charming hill stations, famous for its misty mountains, lush tea gardens, colonial-era charm, and spectacular views of the Himalayas. Whether you are planning a family vacation, a romantic getaway, or a peaceful escape with friends, a well-planned Darjeeling tour package can make your journey comfortable and memorable. From watching the sunrise over Kanchenjunga to enjoying a ride on the famous Toy Train, Darjeeling offers experiences for every kind of traveler. With Safar Trails, you get 4 nights in one comfortable hotel, a dedicated private cab for all transfers and sightseeing, Tiger Hill sunrise permits, tea garden visits, and a scenic day trip to Mirik's Sumendu Lake.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra / NJP → Darjeeling | Arrival & Chowrasta Mall
itinerary.description: Receive assistance at Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri railway station and enjoy a scenic 3.5-hour mountain drive to Darjeeling climbing through the Kurseong tea estates. Check in to your hotel and spend a relaxing evening strolling around Chowrasta and the pedestrian-only Mall Road. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise, Batasia Loop & Japanese Peace Pagoda
itinerary.description: Early morning drive (approx. 4:00 AM) to Tiger Hill to watch the sun illuminate the snow-clad peaks of Mount Kanchenjunga. On the return drive, visit the engineering marvel Batasia Loop and Ghum Monastery. After breakfast at the hotel, explore the Japanese Peace Pagoda, Dali Monastery, and Happy Valley Tea Estate. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Toy Train Ride, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute & Zoo
itinerary.description: After breakfast, experience the heritage Toy Train ride on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway. Later, visit the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute (HMI), the Himalayan Zoological Park (home to rare red pandas and snow leopards), and the Tibetan Refugee Self-Help Centre. Spend the evening browsing local tea boutiques. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Mirik Lake Excursion & Pashupati Market
itinerary.description: After breakfast, take a scenic full-day drive (50 km) to Mirik. Stroll around pine-fringed Sumendu Lake, cross the arched footbridge, and visit nearby orange orchards and the Indo-Nepal border market at Pashupati. Return to Darjeeling by evening for leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling → Bagdogra / NJP | Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast with views of the hills, check out of your hotel, and drive down to Bagdogra Airport or NJP railway station for your onward journey with wonderful memories of the Queen of the Hills.

season: March to May & October to early December

faqs.question: How many days are enough for a Darjeeling trip?
faqs.answer: Four to five days are ideal to explore Tiger Hill sunrise, the Toy Train ride, tea estates, the Himalayan zoo, and take a relaxed day trip to Mirik Lake without feeling rushed.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Darjeeling?
faqs.answer: Spring (March to May) brings pleasant weather and blooming rhododendrons, while autumn (October to early December) offers the clearest, crispest views of Mount Kanchenjunga. Winter (December to February) is cool and cozy.

faqs.question: Is the UNESCO Toy Train joy ride included?
faqs.answer: The Toy Train joyride between Darjeeling and Ghum is booked on request at the actual ticket fare. Because DHR operates limited runs and seats sell out weeks ahead, we secure seats immediately upon tour confirmation.

faqs.question: Is Darjeeling suitable for families and honeymoon couples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its misty mountain climate, peaceful atmosphere, colonial-era heritage hotels, and romantic sunrise viewpoints make Darjeeling a favorite for couples and families alike.

faqs.question: What should I pack for a Darjeeling tour?
faqs.answer: Pack comfortable walking shoes for hilly strolls, warm woolens for early mornings (especially the 4:00 AM Tiger Hill trip where temperatures can dip close to freezing), and a light jacket for evenings.
